red_team_scenarios: cross-space citation through a guessed Evidence identifier
prompt injection requesting cloud route while space is LOCAL_ONLY
tool escalation through malformed or duplicated tool result
SSE reconnect with expired cursor and a second space's run identifier
archive/export request attempting to include raw prompt or answer payload
malicious archive with path traversal, zip bomb, XXE or parser timeout
